audit.whatIsWrong: Four of seven rows disagree with both the packet chart and their own whys: row 0 reads Vayne while whys[0] says 'a pure skill mirror'; row 1 reads Skill while whys[1] gives the short trades to Yone; row 4 reads Vayne while whys[4] says his R chains his all-in over your kite; row 6 reads Yone while whys[6] says Vayne finally outscales.
audit.why: 49.53% over 1496 games — an even-to-losing lane that only flips at two items. Both layers agreed with each other and disagreed with the explanation printed beside them.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 aligned to the packet chart in both layers, ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was generic boilerplate about Final Hour on a stage that is Yone's, and never named Fate Sealed's range or cooldown.
audit.why: Fate Sealed blinks 1000 units behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone hit toward him, on 120/100/80s — that is the level-6 spike, not Final Hour.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten with the range, the pull and the cooldown; phases[6].why now names the actual two-item flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d had no cooldowns, and Spirit Cleave — his shield — appears nowhere on the page.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s, Mortal Steel is 4s and only dashes plus knocks up at 2 stacks of Gathering Storm, and Spirit Cleave shields him on 14s. Bursting into the shield is the specific mistake the 'Fight his E burst' entry was meant to warn about.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten with the real numbers and the two-stack rule.

audit.why: Soul Unbound remains the tracked cooldown and is now stated as 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Yone contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither of you has a trade pattern yet — it is spacing and last-hits, and whoever dodges the first Mortal Steel line leads.

edits.before: Q tumble resets make your spacing untouchable. Only take the trade when Yone's Soul Unbound is down.
edits.after: Mortal Steel is up every 4s and his base stats edge yours — give the short trades and farm at range.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yone's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks 1000 units behind you and drags you in, chaining off Q3 — at 120s it is his all-in, so never fight off a wall.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Yone carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Silver Bolts' true damage ignores his crit-health build and Condemn pins his dash into terrain — your window.

edits.before: His burst window. Condemn him at his return. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — his dive is free until you make him spend it.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mortal Steel only dashes and knocks up at two stacks — count them.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Q3 is his opener and the two stacks expire — break off and reset his count.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s — bursting into it wins nothing.

notes: Both layers agreed with each other here and disagreed with the packet chart and with the whys printed on the same page — a rarer failure than the usual half-updated chart, and it flipped four of seven rows. Whether Condemn's knockback can displace Yone mid-Soul-Unbound, or whether it interacts with the spirit rather than the body, is not answerable from Riot's text and is not asserted.
